source.name: 5 5.1 Knowledge Check
source.instructions: This course uses two separate model groups for Enterprise Search: `openai-gpt-5-mini` and `openai-embeddings`. Why are two model groups needed instead of one?

answers.answer: Rasa requires at least two model groups whenever `EnterpriseSearchPolicy` is enabled
Embedding documents and generating answers are different tasks that need different model types
OpenAI requires separate model groups for chat and embeddings models
The `openai-embeddings` group is only used during training and can be removed afterwards
